parts.name: Fan
parts.Basic_description: This is the rotating fan blade assembly of a cooling fan, made of ABS plastic for durability and lightweight performance.
parts.Functional_description: The fan blades rotate to generate airflow, cooling electronic components or circulating air within a system.
parts.Movement_description: This part rotates around its central axis when powered by the motor, converting electrical energy into mechanical airflow.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or frame of the cooling fan, typically made of aluminum alloy for structural support and heat dissipation.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the fan blades and motor assembly in place, providing mounting points and maintaining the fan’s structural integrity.
parts.Movement_description: This part remains stationary during operation, serving as the fixed support for the rotating fan blades.
